name: Goulet & Rade de Brest terrain
frame: local north-aligned metric frame: x = (lon - lon0) * mx (metres east), n = (lat - lat0) * my (metres north); constant scale factors at lat0 (the grid is therefore regular in WGS84 lon/lat as well)
verticalDatum: NGF-IGN69 (French levelling, ~ mean sea level; at Brest MSL is ~ +0.4 m IGN69). Bathymetry converted from LAT with LAT = -3.64 m IGN69 (Brest chart datum).

demFar.encoding: Int16 little-endian, row-major, row 0 = north edge, column 0 = west edge; height_m = value / 10 (decimetres). Heights relative to NGF/IGN69 (~ mean sea level; water plane at 0). No no-data values.
demFar.pixelRegistration: area: extent = outer pixel edges; pixel (r,c) centre = (xWest + (c+0.5)*res, nNorth - (r+0.5)*res)
demFar.landSource: IGN LiDAR HD MNS (surface model incl. buildings/trees), sampled 5 m x 7.5 m and max-pooled 3x2; RGE ALTI where LiDAR is masked

demNear.encoding: Int16 little-endian, row-major, row 0 = north edge, column 0 = west edge; height_m = value / 10 (decimetres). Heights relative to NGF/IGN69 (~ mean sea level; water plane at 0). No no-data values.
demNear.pixelRegistration: area: extent = outer pixel edges; pixel (r,c) centre = (xWest + (c+0.5)*res, nNorth - (r+0.5)*res)
demNear.landSource: IGN LiDAR HD MNS (surface model incl. buildings/trees), sampled 1.33 m x 2 m and max-pooled 3x2; RGE ALTI where LiDAR is masked

orthoFar.encoding: JPEG quality 85 (progressive), sRGB, row 0 = north edge; exactly the same extent as the matching DEM (pixel edges coincide every 120 m)

orthoNear.encoding: JPEG quality 85 (progressive), sRGB, row 0 = north edge; exactly the same extent as the matching DEM (pixel edges coincide every 120 m)

processing.landSea: Water = Plan IGN v2 water fill that is not firm RGE ALTI ground (>= 1 m), plus areas outside the RGE ALTI domain without a LiDAR-measured structure; only water 4-connected to the open sea becomes sea. RGE ALTI flattened water surfaces (constant -2.79 m sea band, flat estuaries) are ignored. Firm ground: LiDAR HD MNS (buildings, trees), RGE ALTI where the LiDAR is masked (military sites: Brest naval base, Ile Longue, Lanveoc-Poulmic, ...). Foreshore (RGE ALTI < 1 m) not mapped as water: min(LiDAR, RGE ALTI) i.e. ground only. Outside RGE ALTI and not water (recent port polder, breakwaters, rocks): LiDAR where the surface is measured (rough), long narrow high decks over water (bridges) excluded. Measured submerged foreshore (RGE ALTI < 0 m) is kept where shallower than the seabed blend.
processing.removedFromLidar: objects standing on water (moored/anchored ships, buoys, pontoons, bridge decks over water, TIN-interpolated water surfaces) are replaced by water/seabed
processing.seaDepth: smooth-min(max(EMODnet depth LAT->IGN69, shoreDepth*exp(-d/150)), shoreDepth + k * d), d = distance to the nearest non-sea pixel, blend width 3.0 m; shoreDepth = max(0.3 m, -elevation of the adjacent non-sea pixel) and k = 0.05..0.2 (gentle next to low shores, steep next to cliffs/quays >= 4.0 m), both smoothed 40 m along the shore; then a 30 m gaussian over sea pixels faded in from the shoreline. Seabed is ~-0.3 m at a dry shoreline.
processing.lidarPooling: the LiDAR HD WMS pyramid has degree-square pixels and nearest-neighbour resampling, so it is fetched with x step = res/3 and y step = res/2 (square in degrees) and max-pooled 3x2 into each output pixel; the far DEM is therefore a 15 m 'skyline' surface, slightly higher than an average of the near DEM
processing.tideNote: LiDAR HD was flown at various tide states (water surface -2.6..-0.2 m IGN69, sometimes higher in port basins). The water plane of the simulator is 0 m IGN69 (~ mean sea level); foreshore above 0 m appears as land, as at mid tide.
